name: Vigor
summary: An eleven-page fitness tracker: activity rings, live heartbeat, sleep, food, water and workouts
about: A complete personal fitness dashboard in soft neumorphic surfaces, filled with ninety days of activity, sleep, heart rate, food and water for one person. Three activity rings sweep in and sparkle when one closes, a live heartbeat line scrolls with your pulse, and sleep shows its stages through the night. Food, water, workouts with a live session timer, body, goals and reports each have their own page. Good for a fitness app, a smartwatch companion app or a health product, in light and dark.
how: On Today, watch the three rings sweep in; Log a 20 min walk to push them, and a ring that closes sparkles
See your heart beat live on Today and Heart: the line scrolls and the heart pulses at your rate
Press Start workout for a live timer with heart rate, calories and zone; Finish saves it to Workouts
Add foods to each meal from a list of local dishes; the calorie gauge and macro donut update
Tap +250 ml or +500 ml and the glass fills with a moving wave; Undo is in the toast
Read last night's sleep stages, switch Activity between 7D, 30D and 90D, and log weigh-ins and measurements
Edit your goals, check streaks, compare this week with last in Reports and export ninety days as CSV
